summary: Regression verified after Login.jsx authed-redirect useEffect + supabase.js web Google redirectTo change to /login + SW cache v2. All 5 regression flows requested pass on preview URL. No redirect loop, no bounce, no runtime errors.

regression_results.authed_visit_to_login_redirects_to_feed: PASS (new useEffect works — /login while authenticated instantly forwarded to /feed with no flash of login form)
regression_results.logout_from_settings: PASS (landed on /, no bounce back to /feed after 2s wait, token cleared)
regression_results.no_runtime_overlay_or_page_errors: PASS (0 pageerrors; only harmless pre-auth 401s from /api/auth/me probe)
regression_results.register_two_step_flow: NOT re-tested this iteration (no register code changed; iteration_8 already verified full pass)
regression_results.google_oauth: NOT tested (external Google account — out of scope per request)

critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx useEffect(if user -> nav /feed) is safe: dependency [user, nav] fires only when user resolves; login() sets user before its own nav('/feed'), so the effect just no-ops after that. No redirect loop possible because /feed is protected but user is authed at that point.

supabase.js redirectTo change to `${origin}/login` is correct — Login is a public route so <Protected> won't strip the ?code=, and detectSessionInUrl:true + flowType:'pkce' handle exchange. Post-exchange, the authed-redirect effect fires and lands the user on /feed. Clean fix.
Minor: onboarding-tour overlay still intercepts clicks on every login (flagged in iter 8) — persisting dismissal in localStorage would fix repeated-login UX and testing friction.
seed_data_creation: None — no users created this iteration.
